messages:
Ava (PM): Quick design review — want to align on streaming UX for Playground. Two bits: stop/regenerate affordance behavior, and where the token counter lives when streaming.
Sam (Design): TL;DR: prefer a single control that toggles between Stop / Regenerate states instead of separate buttons. Keeps chrome minimal.
Priya (Frontend): Question: toggle implies modal state. How does keyboard focus behave when stream finishes vs user hits stop?
Diego (Eng): From infra side, 'stop' triggers an abort token that closes the KV stream. 'Regenerate' needs to re-run prompt + reset prefix cache. Separate ops under the hood.
Ava (PM): UX trade: single control helps surface mental model but implementation costs are higher. Also copy matters: "Stop" vs "Freeze" vs "Pause".
Sam (Design): I pushed a quick prototype: https://figma.com/file/abc — shows a pill that switches label and icon. Icon is a square for stop, then a circular arrow for regen.
Jules (A11y): Accessibility nit: icon-only changes are bad. Make sure the button has an accessible label that updates (aria-label="Stop generation" -> "Regenerate"). Also announce via aria-live when stream ends.
Priya (Frontend): For the token counter — current idea: token count stays attached to the message bubble (bottom-right). When streaming, show a transient floating token gauge near the Stop button so users see real-time token burn.
Sam (Design): Floating gauge idea good, but it can occlude text on mobile. Maybe collapse to an inline mini-pill on mobile.
Diego (Eng): Real-time token updates will be emitted from the runtime every 250ms; we can throttle on the client to 500ms to save render cycles. Works for the floating gauge.
Priya (Frontend): Implementation sketch:
```
// pseudocode
stream.on('token_update', (n) => {
  throttledUpdate(() => setTokenCount(n))
})
```
We should also animate the counter so it doesn't jump.
Jules (A11y): Important: token counter should not be in the tab order. Use role="status" and aria-live="polite" so screen readers get updates but keyboard focus isn't stolen.
Ava (PM): Copy debate — users asked for "Regenerate" wording in research, not "Run again". Shorter label for compact mode: "Regen"? I hate that.
Sam (Design): Avoid "Regen". Use full words. For compact pill we can show an icon + tooltip with full copy on hover/focus.
Priya (Frontend): Tooltip needs accessible fallback (aria-describedby target). On mobile long-press can show the label.
Diego (Eng): Edge case: when a regenerate is triggered while another request is queued on Dedicated, we should show a small spinner in the pill and disable multiple regen clicks. Backend will return 429 if concurrent. Surface that state.
Ava (PM): Good call. Add small disabled state copy: aria-label="Regenerating — please wait".
Sam (Design): Prompt library integration: when user selects a prompt, the control should indicate origin (e.g., "Prompt: Meeting notes") and Regenerate should re-run with that prompt pinned.
Priya (Frontend): We need a stable way to anchor the token counter when messages collapse (e.g., user collapses a long response). Suggest token count persist in header summary of the message thread.
Jules (A11y): Keyboard behavior for collapse/expand must be predictable. Use roving tabindex for message actions. Also ensure voiceover announces when streaming resumes after pause/stop.
Ava (PM): Decision proposal:
- Use a single pill control that toggles Stop / Regenerate.
- Use full-word labels, icon + text in wide mode; icon-only in compact, with tooltip/aria label.
- Floating token gauge near pill during streaming; collapse to inline pill in compact/mobile. Throttle updates to 500ms and use role="status" for SRs.
- Show spinner/disabled state when regen queued; show 429 message if backend rejects.
Agree?
Diego (Eng): +1 from infra. We'll add a client-side debounce and surface precise error messages from the server.
Sam (Design): +1 with minor tweak — margin between pill and floating gauge should be 8px so it doesn't overlap suggestions. I'll update figma.
Priya (Frontend): +1. I'll prototype with aria-live and the throttled updates. Will ping when ready for dev review.
Jules (A11y): +1. I'll run a quick screen reader pass once the prototype is up.
CI Bot: Build 5178 queued for branch playground/stream-tokenGauge — tests: unit 12/128 failing (flaky).
Ava (PM): Thanks everyone — followups: Priya to post prototype link, Sam to update figma with spacing, Diego to add regen rate-limit behavior in the API spec. We'll reconvene in UX sync.
